children: Poland’s corporate sector wages rose 5.6% year-on-year to PLN 9,259.54 in August 2026, slowing from 6.8% in July and coming below market expectations of 6.6%.
This marked the softest growth in four months.

On a monthly basis, average gross wages fell 2.6%, reversing a 1.1% increase in July, as additional payments, including quarterly, annual and discretionary bonuses, awards and retirement severance payments, declined.
Average paid employment fell 0.8% year-on-year to 6.37 million full-time equivalents, while also declining 0.2% month-on-month.
Year to date, corporate sector wages have risen 5.9%, while employment has fallen 1.0%.
The statutory minimum wage increased 3.0% to PLN 4,806 in January 2026, also contributing to wage growth.

title: Poland Corporate Wage Growth Less Than Expected
